outcome: presence of symptomatic Chiari II at birth
cohort: 215 patients with myelomeningocele at the spina bifida clinic from the National Children's Hospital of Costa Rica who were born between 2004 and 2022
finding: In a cohort of patients with myelomeningocele born after the introduction of mandatory folate fortification, there was a reduction in the severity of myelomeningocele, including a decrease in thoracic/high lumbar lesions and an increase in middle lumbar cases, as well as a decrease in kyphotic deformities and symptomatic Chiari II malformation at birth.
mod_finding: There was an increase in cesarean sections as the method of delivery from 54% pre-fortification to 64% post-fortification.
